title: Troubleshooting required status checks
method: One official documentation page opened after two generic public search queries; no other page opened.
source_authority: Primary vendor documentation for GitHub Actions status checks and merge queues.
locator: Sections 'Handling skipped but required checks' and 'Status checks with GitHub Actions and a Merge queue', lines 83-128; https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/how-tos/merge-and-close-pull-requests/troubleshooting-required-status-checks#status-checks-with-github-actions-and-a-merge-queue

claims.claim: A GitHub Actions check required by a merge queue must be triggered with the separate merge_group event; otherwise the required status may not be reported and the merge fails.
When path, branch, or commit-message filtering skips a workflow that supplies a required check, the associated check stays pending and blocks merging.
A required job depending on a failed job can itself be skipped and may not block merging; GitHub points to always() with needs for required checks depending on other jobs.

derived_proposals: Use one workflow_call DAG behind a pull_request and merge_group caller and a stable final required job; this application is an engineering proposal, not a documented recommendation from the opened page.
Keep SDK/model/degree/proof runs outside the default small-PR path unless their authority and cost requirements make them applicable; the opened source does not establish those requirements.
